decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis app sits close to the core software, was launched as a featured product line, and matches the push toward digital practice workflows, so its results likely meet the aspiration and the growing firm has slack to keep it.

The education institute builds on the firm's training resources and supports customer loyalty; with no sign of a shortfall and a growing firm able to carry it, there is little reason for problemistic search.
Remote screen-sharing support is cheap to run and central to efficient customer support, so it most likely performs satisfactorily and stays.
The analytics dashboard extends the core data offering and fits the firm's direction toward efficiently managed practices; slack from growth allows it to be carried while its results mature.
The practice bundle is a packaging of established products with low incremental cost, so it is likely to meet aspirations and remain on offer.

The listing portal is distant from the core business and was only mentioned on the website, so its results are uncertain and possibly below aspiration, but low running costs and slack from growth make keeping it slightly more likely than dropping it.
